abstract: In the group of 17 women after surgery with histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of teratomas diagnostic usefulness of US and CT was analysed. Differentiated echostructure of tumours was correlated with different densities of pathologic tissues in CT examination, also after their contrast enhancement. In 2 patients teratomas of both ovaries were recognised, in the remaining 15 women tumours were unilateral. In total morphologic pictures of 19 teratomas were assessed, 9 times tumours with prevailing liquid component had the picture of a thick-walled cyst, 7 times these were hyperechogenic fatty foci and in 3 cases had the character of solid tumours. Teratomas had different morphologic pictures, but it was possible to show the prevalence of one element and classify the tumour to one of the three types of teratomas. It was found that US examination, due to its high frequency, lets early diagnose teratomas before they are accessible in the clinical exam, in the symptomless period or when they give indirect symptoms, usually dysuric ones. CT examination, due to its high sensitivity in recognising fatty tissue and calcifications, is necessary before laparoscopic operation requiring fragmentation of big tumours to determine their character.
abstract_ja: 組織学的に確定診断された奇形腫の手術を受けた女性17例を対象に、超音波検査とCTの診断的有用性を分析した。腫瘍のエコー構造の違いを、CT検査での病変組織の濃度差(造影後を含む)と対応させた。2例では両側の卵巣に奇形腫が認められ、残る15例は片側性であった。計19個の奇形腫の全体的な画像所見を評価した。9例は厚い壁の嚢胞として、7例は高エコーの脂肪巣として、3例は充実性腫瘍としての所見を示した。奇形腫は画像所見が多様であったが、一つの成分が優勢であることを示し、腫瘍を3つの型のいずれかに分類することが可能であった。超音波検査は周波数が高いため、臨床診察で触知可能になる前、無症状期、あるいは排尿障害などの間接的な症状が現れた段階で奇形腫を早期に診断できることが示された。CT検査は脂肪組織と石灰化の検出感度が高いため、断片化が必要な大きな腫瘍を腹腔鏡手術で扱う前に、腫瘍の性状を確認する目的で必要である。
